_README: Manually captured external-book receipts for the Hotspawn LoL pick'em list.
Why manual: the GitHub Actions runner is blocked by these sites (see data/probe/sources_probe.json
from session a91e528d: EGamersWorld 403, Oddspedia 410, Sofascore 403, bo3.gg 200 but JavaScript-only).
A research sandbox with a normal browser user-agent can read them, so a human/agent captures the
published decimal prices verbatim, with the page URL and the UTC capture time, and commits them here.
1. every capture must name a Hotspawn fixture id that exists in data/matches.json;
2. every decimal price must be > 1.0 (a price is never inferred, interpolated or copied);
3. symmetric 1.80/1.80 style placeholders are recorded but classified 'placeholder' and never used;
4. receipts are corroboration only -- they never change a published pick or its probability.
Nothing in this file is scraped automatically and nothing is generated by a model.

sources.name: bo3.gg LoL match centre
sources.kind: esports odds display (prices link to the Thunderpick affiliate feed)
sources.runner_reachable: HTTP 200 from Actions, but the price cells are rendered client-side, so the runner receives no prices
sources.note: Displayed clock is UTC-4 (US Eastern). 13:00 on the page == 17:00Z, matching Hotspawn/Pinnacle.

sources.name: EGamersWorld LoL
sources.kind: esports odds aggregator (best-price average across books)
sources.runner_reachable: HTTP 403 from Actions (bot protection); readable from a browser user-agent
sources.note: Displayed clock is UTC-4 (US Eastern). Prices moved between two reads 4 minutes apart; both reads are recorded.

sources.name: OddsPortal eSports / League of Legends
sources.kind: odds comparison engine (coverage check only, no prices read)
sources.runner_reachable: HTTP 200 from Actions, JavaScript-rendered; used for coverage only

conflict.reason: The archived 2026-10-21 reading (1.025 / 10.5 = 91.1% for Ground Zero Gaming) is not reproducible today: this page publishes the symmetric 1.8 / 1.8 placeholder, and the listing still shows 1.025 / 10.5 for the same card. Dropping that archived quote changed the published pick on this card from Ground Zero Gaming 91.1% to Frank Esports 77.5% (model line) - a 68.6 pp swing driven entirely by a two-day-old aggregator reading. Which team the archived prices even belonged to cannot be confirmed from the source, so neither reading is used.

coverage_observations.observation: The odds-comparison engine lists exactly one priced LoL competition: 'League of Legends World Championship (8)'. No tier-2 or national division appears anywhere in its LoL section.

Of the 241 Hotspawn LoL cards, the aggregator publishes prices for three competitions only: 2026 World Championship (8 matches), LGC 2026 Rising (1 match) and LCP 2027 Promotion (2 matches, one of them the symmetric placeholder). PRM 2nd Division (40), PRM 3rd Division (62), Tunisian Super League (25), RIVALS LEAGUE Season 2 (28) and every other national division carry no price at all.
